lines.text: Every day, India's food brands write off good stock that sells too slowly.
FSSAI sets a bare minimum for e-commerce: thirty percent of shelf life, or forty-five days.
lines.say: F S S A I sets a bare minimum for e-commerce: thirty percent of shelf life, or forty-five days.

lines.text: This batch has just twenty-two days left. Too close to its date for quick commerce, it's about to be destroyed.
Smart-Clearance turns that write-off into recovery.
Agentic software as a service, for FMCG.
lines.say: Agentic software as a service, for F M C G.

lines.text: Under the hood, it's all Google Cloud.
Four apps on Firebase, one API on Cloud Run, and Cloud SQL as the record.
Pub/Sub carries every step, and Cloud Scheduler keeps the clock.
lines.say: Pub Sub carries every step, and Cloud Scheduler keeps the clock.

lines.text: Nine AI agents on Google's ADK read sales from BigQuery, and photos from Cloud Storage.
lines.say: Nine AI agents on Google's A D K read sales from BigQuery, and photos from Cloud Storage.

lines.text: On Google's Agent Platform, Gemini Pro prices and negotiates, while Flash reads and writes.
And the models never touch the money: the API works out every figure, and a person says yes.
So today, I'll walk you through two journeys, running live in production: Munchly Foods, an imaginary brand, with two batches at two distributors. One happy path, and one sad path.
There are two ways in. Munchly, its distributors and its kiranas share one workspace, and Neha, from our team, opens the console.
In the console, Neha can set up a brand in minutes: its stock export, its people, its quick-commerce gates, and its agents.
Every workspace installs as an app, on any laptop, tablet or phone.
Here's Priya, who runs supply chain at Munchly, signing in.
Her Command Center tracks every batch at risk: the days left, the sell-through, and what the bin would cost.
This morning, reading sell-through from BigQuery, the Watcher flags two batches: the Mango Drink and the Masala Chips.
First, the Mango Drink. Lakshmi Agencies photographs the label, and Vision, on Gemini Flash, matches it to the stock export.
From the batch's sales history and Munchly's own rules, the Valuer prices every exit, and the Router splits the batch. Priya approves the plan with one tap.
Outreach offers the packs to fifty-eight kiranas, each in their own language, and every order lands on Priya's screen, live.
Fifty-two shops take thirteen hundred and seventy-two packets, and each order gets its own GST invoice.
At the godown, staff buy a hundred and fifty packs by UPI, and Vision checks the receipt against the count.
lines.say: At the godown, staff buy a hundred and fifty packs by U P I, and Vision checks the receipt against the count.

lines.text: Feeding India collects the last fifty-eight packs, and issues a donation receipt.
Paperwork files every paper in Cloud Storage, and Lakshmi Agencies ends whole, to the rupee.
But not every batch sells. Munchly's Masala Chips go to Rakesh Traders' kiranas in Nagpur, and only two shops order.
So on ExpireSoon, an imaginary near-expiry marketplace, the Negotiator counters a bid, and seven hundred and seventy-two packs sell.
lines.say: So on Expire Soon, an imaginary near-expiry marketplace, the Negotiator counters a bid, and seven hundred and seventy-two packs sell.

lines.text: When the offer window closes, five hundred and forty packets are still left.
On expiry day, Rakesh has to destroy them through an authorised agency, and prove it.
At the landfill he photographs the destruction, and the officer, two witnesses and Rakesh sign the certificate.
lines.style: Say this one a little slower and steadier than the rest, unhurried, giving each person their moment as you name them: the officer, two witnesses and Rakesh. No rush to the end.

lines.text: Vision checks the photos, and only on Priya's second yes are the certificate and the credit note issued.
And every step is on the record: an append-only audit trail in Cloud SQL, and every request traced in Cloud Trace. Cloud Monitoring watches it all, and alerts the team the moment a model call fails.
Even on this sad path, Munchly recovers eleven thousand seven hundred rupees, and Rakesh ends whole.
And finally, Impact posts every batch to its ledger in BigQuery, ready for BRSR.
lines.say: And finally, Impact posts every batch to its ledger in BigQuery, ready for B R S R.
